title: Smart home hub
summary: One hub to control all your smart home devices.
whyTempting: Smart homes are fragmented and frustrating.
whyItFails: Big tech dominates. Apple, Google and Amazon own the platform. Standards churn. Protocols keep changing. Hardware economics. Margins are thin.
whatWouldChange: Matter standard reducing fragmentation (also reducing the need for hubs).

attempts.outcome: Changed owners several times; moved to paid subscription in 2020
attempts.notes: Spun out of Quirky; users had to pay monthly or lose control of their devices.

attempts.outcome: Shut down after Lowe's failed to sell it
Acquired by Nest, then devices disabled
attempts.notes: Nest remotely bricked all hubs in May 2016 despite 'lifetime' subscriptions.

reasons.detail: Big tech dominates: Apple, Google and Amazon own the platform.
